newsitem.title: USA: IVAX gets FDA okay on 2 nadolol doseages.
newsitem.headline: IVAX gets FDA okay on 2 nadolol doseages.

text.p: IVAX Corp said on Tuesday that the United States Food and Drug Administration approved an Abbreviated New Drug Application for its generic pharmaceutical product nadolol in 20 and 40 mg tablets.
IVAX said that nadolol, which is indicated for the management of hypertension and angina pectoris, is the generic equivalent of Bristol-Myers Squibb Co's Corgard.
The company said that it had already had approval to manufacture nadolol in 80, 120 and 160 mg tablets.
It said that now it has authority to manufacture all five available dosage strengths of nadolol.
